name: SousShift AI
facts: SousShift AI builds branded apps, custom games and rewards for restaurants and local businesses. It is pronounced SOO-shift, like sous chef.
Guests scan a QR code and the app opens in their phone browser. There is nothing to download.
Restaurant plans are priced per restaurant: Basic $3,000 setup + $350/mo, Growth $3,500 setup + $650/mo, Done-for-you $4,000 setup + $950/mo.
AI add-ons are priced per location per month: AI Text Assistant $75/mo and AI Voice Host + Text $150/mo. They are month to month.
Contact: secondshiftai@gmail.com, Instagram @SousShiftAi, or the 24/7 AI sales line (424) 296-3303. Nia, SousShift's AI guide, answers it. The line takes calls only, not texts.
Every plan includes points and rewards, invite-a-friend referrals, a custom game with a weekly leaderboard and giveaway, your customer list, and a QR print kit.

Live demos: Melody Bar & Grill (flight game), Nalu Vida (surf game), Gritz N Wafflez (Order Up!), StormBurger (Storm Run), Churrito Loco (Loco Match), Lucky Dragon (Hibachi Catch), plus mechanic, ice cream truck, food truck and gym apps.
Melody Bar & Grill is the first onboarded partner and is going live now. Nalu Vida and Gritz N Wafflez are still in the works and not live yet.
A free sample app takes about 3 minutes to request. Antidote builds it personally, usually the same day, with no card and no pressure.
Setup payment options: pay in full, split 50/50, or a flexible plan from $750 down with the rest spread over 12 months at no extra charge.
Plans have a 3-month minimum, then month to month with 30 days' written notice. You keep your customer list and can export it.
The app works with any register (Toast, Square, Clover and others) and nothing needs to be installed.
The menu comes in 12 languages and the staff app comes in English and Spanish.
Existing clients keep their signed deals. These prices are for new restaurants.
Results are estimates, not promises. SousShift does not guarantee sales or follower counts.

qa.q: What is SousShift AI?
qa.a: SousShift AI builds branded apps, custom games and rewards for restaurants and local businesses. Guests scan a QR, play your game, join your rewards and come back.

qa.q: How do you say SousShift?
qa.a: Say it SOO-shift, like sous chef.

qa.q: How much does it cost?
qa.a: Per restaurant: Basic is $3,000 setup + $350/mo, Growth is $3,500 + $650/mo, and Done-for-you is $4,000 + $950/mo. AI add-ons are extra unless your plan includes them.

qa.q: What's in the Basic plan?
qa.a: Basic is $3,000 setup + $350/mo. It has your branded app with ordering and table QR, a 4K photo menu with 3D dishes, a menu in 12 languages, points and rewards, referrals, a custom game with weekly leaderboard and giveaway, your customer list, email, an Instagram feed, the print-kit design, a promo video, and hosting and support.

qa.q: What's in the Growth plan?
qa.a: Growth is $3,500 setup + $650/mo. It's everything in Basic plus Google review prompts, nearby GPS alerts, the AI Text Assistant, automatic birthday and we-miss-you texts, missed-call text-back, and we place your print order.

qa.q: What's in Done-for-you?
qa.a: Done-for-you is $4,000 setup + $950/mo. It's everything in Growth plus the AI Voice Host answering your phone and us running your texting and marketing. You approve, we do the work.

qa.q: Which plan should I pick?
qa.a: Basic if you're happy to send your own texts and place your own printing. Growth if you want guests brought back automatically. Done-for-you if you want to sit back while we run marketing and answer your phone.

qa.q: What do I have to do on each plan?
qa.a: Basic: you send your own texts and promotions, print the stickers (we give you the files) and keep your deals updated. Growth: bring-back texts run themselves and we order your printing. Done-for-you: we run texting, promotions and printing.

qa.q: What's included versus add-ons?
qa.a: Everything listed in your plan is included. Add-ons cost extra: Online Ordering + Delivery (coming soon), Social & SEO Growth, the Sports Bar Package, the Games Pack, and the 3D Digital Menu. The AI Text Assistant and AI Voice Host are included in the higher plans.

qa.q: How much are the AI agents?
qa.a: The AI Text Assistant is $75/mo and the AI Voice Host + Text is $150/mo, both per location. Text is included in Growth and Done-for-you, and Voice is included in Done-for-you.

qa.q: What does the AI Text Assistant do?
qa.a: It texts customers back 24/7 about hours, menu, specials, reservation requests and catering. Missed calls get a text back too, and anything it can't answer goes to you or your manager.

qa.q: What does the AI Voice Host do?
qa.a: A natural AI voice answers your phone 24/7 or only after hours, takes reservation requests, transfers to staff and texts links like the menu or directions. It's $150/mo per location and includes the Text Assistant.

qa.q: How many texts and minutes are included in the AI agents?
qa.a: The Text Assistant includes 1,000 texts a month, then $0.03 a text. The Voice Host includes 750 call minutes plus 1,000 texts, then $0.15 a minute and $0.03 a text. We tell you before you go over.

qa.q: Does the AI sound like a robot?
qa.a: It uses a natural, modern AI voice, and you can try it yourself with the demo hosts Kira (Melody) and Kai (Nalu Vida) on our agents page. It tells callers it's an AI if asked and never pretends to be a person.

qa.q: Can the AI take reservations?
qa.a: It collects reservation requests (name, party size, date, time, phone) and sends them to your staff to confirm. It doesn't book into your system or promise a table on its own.

qa.q: What if the AI doesn't know an answer?
qa.a: It doesn't guess. It tells the customer a person will follow up and texts you or your manager the question with the customer's name and number.

qa.q: What phone number does the AI use?
qa.a: Your existing number through call forwarding (we walk you through it) or a new local number we set up. For texting on your existing number, we register it with the carriers.

qa.q: Are there texting rules I need to worry about?
qa.a: We handle them for you. Promotional texts only go to people who opted in, STOP is honored, and nothing promotional goes out outside 8 AM to 9 PM. We also handle the carrier registration (A2P 10DLC), which usually takes a few days.

qa.q: Is the AI add-on a contract?
qa.a: No long contract. The AI agents are month to month per location, and you can switch tiers or cancel anytime.

qa.q: How long does it take to set up the AI agents?
qa.a: We load your hours, menu, specials and FAQs and test it with you. Texting needs carrier registration (usually a few days), and the voice host needs call forwarding on your number. We handle both.

qa.q: Can I try the AI voice host?
qa.a: Yes. On the agents page you can talk to Kira (Melody Bar & Grill) or Kai (Nalu Vida) in your browser. The demos don't take real reservations or orders.

qa.q: What is Online Ordering + Delivery?
qa.a: Guests order and pay by card in your app, pickup first, with points on every order. It's coming soon at $300/mo flat or $200/mo + 5% of the food on each order. Delivery by DoorDash drivers depends on DoorDash approving our access (applied, under review).

qa.q: How does the 5% ordering option work?
qa.a: On the $200/mo option you pay 5% of the food on each app order, never on delivery fees, tips or tax. A $40 order is $2, and nothing is added to your guests' checks. Flat $300 is cheaper once you do over $2,000 a month in app orders.

qa.q: Can guests order from the table?
qa.a: Yes. Every plan includes a branded app with ordering and a QR at every table, so guests can send their order from their seat. Online pickup ordering and delivery are a coming-soon add-on.

qa.q: Do you offer delivery?
qa.a: Not yet. Delivery through DoorDash drivers is coming once DoorDash approves our access, and your current delivery setup stays as it is.

qa.q: What is Social & SEO Growth?
qa.a: An optional $1,000/mo add-on: a monthly content plan, short videos from your food, posting on Instagram, TikTok and YouTube, Google Business Profile and local SEO, and a monthly report. Results vary and we don't guarantee follower or view counts.

qa.q: Is there a bundle?
qa.a: Yes, the Everything bundle is Done-for-you plus Social & SEO Growth with $150 off the monthly. That's $4,000 setup + $1,800/mo.

qa.q: What is the Sports Bar Package?
qa.a: An add-on with live local scores, follow-your-team alerts, the Fan Test, Football Squares, fight nights and pick-the-winner points. It's quoted separately, so ask us for pricing.

qa.q: What is the Games Pack?
qa.a: An add-on with trivia, sports trivia, a daily word game, word scramble and bar-safe Truth or Dare. Guests earn points for playing, and pricing is quoted separately.

qa.q: What is the 3D Digital Menu add-on?
qa.a: Guests spin real 3D models of your signature dishes, plus slow-motion food clips and a real-photo mode. It's quoted separately, so ask us for pricing.

qa.q: How can I pay the setup?
qa.a: Three ways: pay in full, split 50/50 (half at signing, half when your app is delivered), or the flexible plan. The monthly starts the day you sign.

qa.q: How does the flexible payment plan work?
qa.a: Put at least $750 down per restaurant, and the rest of the setup is spread over 12 months added to your monthly, with no extra charge. After 12 months the monthly drops back to normal. Example: Basic with $750 down is about $537.50/mo for 12 months.

qa.q: Can I pay 50/50?
qa.a: Yes. Half of the setup is due when you sign and the other half when your app is delivered (Go-Live).

qa.q: Can I pay by card?
qa.a: Yes. You can pay in full by card through Stripe, which covers the setup plus your first month, then the monthly continues automatically. Ask us and we'll send your own link.

qa.q: Is there a contract or can I cancel?
qa.a: There's a 3-month minimum, then it's month to month, and either side can cancel with 30 days' written notice (email counts). AI add-ons are month to month from day one.

qa.q: What is the 10% performance share?
qa.a: Only in a month your app customers spend over $3,000 on food and non-alcoholic drinks, we get 10% of just the amount over $3,000. For example $5,000 in app sales means $200. Under $3,000 nothing extra is owed, and it never applies to alcohol, tax, tips or your overall sales.

qa.q: What if the app doesn't bring customers back?
qa.a: There's a results promise: if in your first 3 months after Go-Live there's no 30-day period with at least 30 tracked return visits, you get 2 months of service free. It's a results promise, not a promise of sales.

qa.q: Who owns my customer list?
qa.a: You do. You get full access and a CSV export anytime, and a complete export if you ever stop. We never sell it or use it for another business.

qa.q: What's the onboarding process?
qa.a: First tell us about your business and we build a free sample with your real menu. Then we build your app with your logo, colors, a game made for your food and rewards you choose. Then QR codes go on your tables and window, and guests scan, play, earn rewards and return.

qa.q: How long does it take to go live?
qa.a: Most restaurants go live within a couple of weeks of getting us the menu, photos and logo. The free sample is usually built the same day you request it.

qa.q: How do I get a free sample?
qa.a: Fill out the quick form on our site (about 3 minutes) with your business type, a few menu items and 2-6 photos. Antidote reviews it personally and builds your sample, usually the same day, with no card and no pressure.

qa.q: How do I book a call or demo?
qa.a: Request the free sample on our site, email secondshiftai@gmail.com, DM @SousShiftAi on Instagram, or call (424) 296-3303 any time.

qa.q: Can I just talk to someone?
qa.a: Yes. Call (424) 296-3303 any time, day or night. Nia, SousShift's AI guide, explains the plans and add-ons, answers your questions and connects you to Antidote. It's calls only, so texts to that number don't work yet.

qa.q: Who is Nia?
qa.a: Nia is SousShift's AI guide on our 24/7 sales line, (424) 296-3303. She explains plans and add-ons, answers questions about SousShift and connects callers to Antidote.

qa.q: Can I text the sales line?
qa.a: Not yet. The (424) 296-3303 line takes calls only. For written questions, email secondshiftai@gmail.com or DM @SousShiftAi on Instagram.

qa.q: What's your email?
qa.a: secondshiftai@gmail.com.

qa.q: What's your Instagram?
qa.a: @SousShiftAi. You can DM us there.

qa.q: What's your phone number?
qa.a: (424) 296-3303, open 24/7 and answered by Nia, our AI guide. Calls only.

qa.q: How do customers get the app?
qa.a: They scan the QR code on the table, window or receipt and it opens in their phone browser, with no app store and no account. They can add it to their home screen, which takes one tap on iPhone or Android.

qa.q: Do customers have to download anything?
qa.a: No. The app opens from a QR code in the browser. Apple App Store and Google Play versions are coming soon.

qa.q: Are you on the App Store or Google Play?
qa.a: Not yet, it's coming soon. Until then the app works on any phone from a QR code with nothing to download.

qa.q: How do rewards and points work?
qa.a: Customers earn points on every visit and level up from Regular to VIP to Legend, with a birthday treat. Points unlock rewards you choose, and each member also gets a gold loyalty card ID that staff can scan.

qa.q: How does the weekly contest work?
qa.a: Your custom game has a weekly leaderboard, and the top score wins a prize you choose, like a free item. There's also a free daily spin and a weekly giveaway.

qa.q: How do leaderboards work?
qa.a: Every game score goes on your leaderboard, which resets weekly, and the weekly champion wins the prize. Guests see the prize board in the app, which is a reason to come back each week.

qa.q: How do referrals work?
qa.a: Customers get an invite-a-friend code. When a friend joins, they earn rewards, and you can see who brings in the most people.

qa.q: What are the QR codes and table cards?
qa.a: Every plan includes designs for QR table stickers, a 24x36 window poster and numbered table cards. Guests scan the code to open your app.

qa.q: Who prints the stickers and posters?
qa.a: On Basic you order and place them using our print-ready files. On Growth and Done-for-you we place the order and bill the print cost at cost, with no markup.

qa.q: How much does printing cost?
qa.a: Typically about $100 to $165 per restaurant for 50-100 stickers, one poster and 50 table cards, based on published prices. Shipping and tax are extra.

qa.q: Does it work with Toast or Square?
qa.a: Yes. It works with any register, including Toast, Square and Clover, and nothing needs to be installed. Staff look up a member by phone or scan their code, and discount buttons connect it to your register.

qa.q: We already have Toast or Square. Do I need to replace it?
qa.a: No, keep your register. SousShift sits on top of it with your own app, game and rewards, which cover loyalty and marketing that registers charge extra for.

qa.q: We already use Owner.com or another ordering app. Can I still use SousShift?
qa.a: Yes, keep your ordering. SousShift adds what ordering apps usually don't have: your own game, rewards for dine-in visits, a QR that needs no download, and a bilingual staff app.

qa.q: What languages are supported?
qa.a: The menu comes in 12 languages, including Spanish, Chinese, Korean, Armenian and Russian, one tap away. The staff app comes in English and Spanish.

qa.q: What is the staff app?
qa.a: A step-by-step training app with real screenshots, a Listen button and a quiz, in English and Spanish. It has no customer data.

qa.q: What is the owner back office?
qa.a: It's one place for members, visits, rewards and prices, with team access you control. You decide what each employee can see and change, and every change is logged.

qa.q: How do you stop fake points or cheating?
qa.a: The Scout fraud guard catches point farming, duplicate accounts and fake receipt claims before anyone gets rewarded.

qa.q: Do you have holiday themes?
qa.a: Yes. Halloween, Thanksgiving, Christmas and more switch on and off by themselves.

qa.q: Can I give an early-bird gift or raffle?
qa.a: Yes. You can reward your first members with a founding gift or a raffle drawing to fill your list fast.

qa.q: Does it bring customers back by text?
qa.a: On Growth and Done-for-you, automatic bring-back texts cover birthdays, we-miss-you and holidays. Basic includes email to your list, and you send your own texts. Texts only go to people who opted in.

qa.q: Do you help with Google reviews?
qa.a: Growth and Done-for-you include Google review prompts, a one-tap review nudge when a guest has just won or enjoyed something.

qa.q: What are nearby GPS alerts?
qa.a: A Growth feature that alerts app users when they're near your location. It's included in Growth and Done-for-you.

qa.q: Which live demos can I try?
qa.a: Melody Bar & Grill (flight game), Nalu Vida (surf game), Gritz N Wafflez (Order Up!), StormBurger (Storm Run), Churrito Loco (Loco Match puzzle) and Lucky Dragon Hibachi (Hibachi Catch). There are also a food truck app, an ice cream truck app, an auto shop app and a gym app.

qa.q: Tell me about the Melody Bar & Grill demo.
qa.a: Melody in Westchester by LAX has a flight game where you land the plane at LAX for prizes, plus table ordering, a Just Landed deal for travelers, a weekly champion and a gold card. It's our first onboarded partner and is going live now.

qa.q: Tell me about the Nalu Vida demo.
qa.a: Nalu Vida is a Venice Pier beach bar demo with the Ride the Nalu surf game, a 4K menu, live happy-hour and brunch status, and a weekly champion. It's still in the works and not live yet.

qa.q: Tell me about the Gritz N Wafflez demo.
qa.a: Gritz N Wafflez is a Koreatown breakfast spot. Its Order Up! game has you run the kitchen and serve plates while you wait, with a weekly prize board and a karaoke shoutout for the top score. It's still in the works.

qa.q: Tell me about the StormBurger demo.
qa.a: StormBurger (Inglewood and Long Beach) has the Storm Run 3D driving game with weekly prizes, a menu with real photos and food in 3D, and rewards.

qa.q: Tell me about the Churrito Loco demo.
qa.a: Churrito Loco in South Gate has Loco Match, a Candy-Crush style puzzle game with their mascot, built around their churros and Mexican street food menu.

qa.q: Tell me about the Lucky Dragon demo.
qa.a: Lucky Dragon Hibachi in Compton has the Hibachi Catch dragon game plus a build-your-hibachi-plate menu.

qa.q: Is there a mechanic or auto shop demo?
qa.a: Yes. Customers type or tap what's wrong, see a sample price or ask for a quote, check tire stock, book a time and pay by QR. You get the job with year, make, model, VIN and trouble codes filled in. Mechanic pricing is set per shop, so contact us for a quote.

qa.q: Is there an ice cream truck demo?
qa.a: Yes. Customers scan your QR once, then see a live truck map and get Truck's on your street alerts with an ETA. They check in 5 times for 10% off or an extra scoop, and earn points on purchases.

qa.q: Is there a food truck demo?
qa.a: Yes, Taco Titan. It has a live truck map, parked-near-you alerts, a countdown when you head their way, and order ahead timed so food comes off the grill as they walk up.

qa.q: Is there a gym demo?
qa.a: Yes, ALL-ONE GYM in Lakewood: a member app with QR check-in, a workout plan and 10-for-10 prizes.

qa.q: How much are the truck plans?
qa.a: The same plans cover ice cream and food trucks. Single Scoop is $99 setup + $29/mo for 1 truck. Double Scoop is $299 setup ($199 for the first 10 trucks) + $50/mo. Sundae is $599 + $129/mo for up to 3 trucks. Ordering ahead comes with Double Scoop and up.

qa.q: Do trucks have a contract?
qa.a: No contract on the truck plans. You can move up or down any time.

qa.q: Do you build websites?
qa.a: Yes, for any business: a fast, phone-first website of up to 5 pages, ready in 7-10 days with 2 rounds of changes. Online stores, booking systems or more than 5 pages get a custom quote.

qa.q: How much is a website?
qa.a: Basic Care is $1,500 + $99/mo, Full Care is $1,500 + $199/mo with unlimited small edits and fixes, and Own It is $2,500 once with no monthly fee. The monthly options have a 3-month minimum, then month to month.

qa.q: What website add-ons are there?
qa.a: An AI chat box is $49/mo and an AI phone host + texting is $150/mo (text-only $75). One-time options are search $150, booking requests $250, 12 languages $250, Google reviews $100, email and text signup $150, photo gallery and video $200, extra page $150 and logo design $300.

qa.q: Will the app pay for itself?
qa.a: The calculator on our site lets you plug in your own numbers. At a $25 average spend, Basic breaks even at about 14 extra visits a month. These are estimates, not a promise of sales.

qa.q: How does this compare to buying the pieces separately?
qa.a: Separately you'd pay different companies for ordering, loyalty, texts, email, reviews, a custom game, photos and design. Our site shows average published prices for each piece next to your plan.

qa.q: I'm already a client. Do my prices change?
qa.a: No. Signed deals keep their terms, and these prices are for new restaurants.

qa.q: I have more than one location.
qa.a: Prices are per restaurant, and AI agents are per location. The $3,000 performance-share test is counted per restaurant, and the plan builder on our site totals any number of locations.

qa.q: Do you offer a discount?
qa.a: Our published prices are the ones above. Any founding discount is agreed in your contract and holds for 3 business days after signing, so ask Antidote what's available.

qa.q: Will you guarantee more sales?
qa.a: No. We don't promise sales or follower counts. What we offer is the results promise: at least 30 tracked return visits in a 30-day period within your first 3 months, or 2 months free.

qa.q: Do you handle my menu and photos?
qa.a: Yes. Your 4K photo menu with 3D dishes is built from your real menu, and we update menu and prices on request. Send us your menu, photos and logo.

qa.q: Do I get a promo video?
qa.a: Yes. The Basic plan includes a promo video, and you also get exposure on Antidote's food-review audience. We don't promise view counts or customers from it.

qa.q: Who is Antidote?
qa.a: Antidote is the founder who personally reviews each free sample and builds your app. He's also known as Antidote the Foodie for his food reviews.

qa.q: What kinds of businesses do you build for?
qa.a: Restaurants, bars, cafes, food and ice cream trucks, dessert shops, bakeries, mechanics and auto shops, barbershops, salons, gyms, car washes, retail stores, boba and coffee shops, and more. Each gets an app and a game that fits the business.

qa.q: Can you make a custom game for my business?
qa.a: Yes. Every plan includes a custom game themed to your business, with a weekly leaderboard and prize. Existing demos show the style, and anything not shown in a demo would be a custom build.

qa.q: Do I need to know tech stuff?
qa.a: No. We build and host it, and you tap through setup and send us your menu, photos and logo. Support is included in every plan.

qa.q: Is it safe for kids or customers who drink?
qa.a: The games have Kid and Adult modes, and the Games Pack includes bar-safe Truth or Dare. Texts only go to people who opted in.
